# LLM Navigation Map

## Project

**Manifest** — head (meta) project: defines the architecture of LLM
instruction files.
Entry point: `AGENTS.md`

## Reference projects

* Manifest — this project (documentation-based). Entry: `AGENTS.md`.
* InvestPlan — code-based reference project (`C:\WorkProjects\InvestPlan`). Entry: `C:\WorkProjects\InvestPlan\AGENTS.md`.

## Directories

* `docs/` — project documentation.
* `docs/plans/` — plan files (stored compressed; `.en.md` is authoritative).
* `workflow/` — OpenSpec user–agent interaction process
  (roles, 7 steps, gates) — DRAFT, in development. Entry:
  `workflow/README.en.md`. File naming rules:
  `workflow/file-naming-rules.en.md`. File structure rules:
  `workflow/file-structure-rules.en.md`. File versioning rules:
  `workflow/file-versioning-rules.en.md`.
* `temp/` — scratch space (gitignored).
* `roadmap.en.md` — planned workflow work (not yet implemented).

## Build

No build step; runs from source.

## Rules

* Workflow: `AGENTS.md`
* Versioning: `VERSIONING.md`
* Releases: `releases.md`
* Commits: `commit-rules.md`
* OpenSpec tasks: `openspec-rules.md`
* Access boundaries: `.llmignore` (read first)

## Sub-projects

* **Skills** — **separate project**: `C:\WorkProjects\skills\`
  (compress-context, compress-context-benchmark). Do not edit here.
* **context-files-guard** — **separate project**: `C:\WorkProjects\context-files-guard\`
  (the add-context-files-guard change). Do not edit here.
* `handy-dictation-scrubber/` — **separate project**: `C:\WorkProjects\handy-dictation-scrubber\`.
  Agent file: `C:\WorkProjects\handy-dictation-scrubber\dictation-scrubber\AGENTS.md`.
* Task-size calibration (measured on the sequential-ratio-compression
  run): doc task ~2-3 min, code task with scripted verification ~5-8 min;
  split by deliverable files; executor commits after each stage;
  heavy verification is its own task; >10 min → split in next revision.
